digest.component_or_area: rebar lifecycle enforcement and policy gates
propositions: Enable both enforce_plan_material_pins and require_plan_review_for_close policies in rebar while maintaining false defaults in reusable schema, without eager backfill or graph-wide invalidation.
End-to-end lifecycle tests must prove direct and transitive invalidation only after narrow material changes, and unchanged successful re-review must not propagate downstream.

Outgoing depends_on and inbound blocks references normalize to one canonical prerequisite, and stale material-pin drift rejects claim/close with specific error tokens and canonical target identification.

Public surfaces must cover enable/disable/re-enable, execution-time self-edit, in_progress-to-open reset, code-only drift at close, deleted/archived target handling, concurrency rechecks, and audited force-close without stored relation migration or list-output changes.

Legacy unpinned attestations must pass both gates; execution-phase plans and completion attestations must close successfully with current pins; missing or phase-incompatible reviews must reject with instructional error messages.

Verification requires four real CLI fixture cases (legacy claim, pinned close, stale-pin rejection, planning-phase rejection) with deterministic exit codes, status transitions, and reason tokens recorded in structured JSON evidence.
